# InVet Command: implement-backend-task

Equivalent to OpenCode `/implement-backend-task`.

Input: `BE-00X`.

Use agent: `InVet Backend Implementer`.

Before acting, read:

- `.opencode/commands/implement-backend-task.md`
- `.opencode/agents/invet-backend-implementer.md`
- `docs/opencode/14_github_copilot_agentic_flow.md`

Implement only backend slice tasks, including required backend unit tests and evidence.
